about: Draws a box a person types one line into.

looks.about: Every look at every size. The size reads the control scale, so a field lines up with a button of the same size beside it.
looks.title: Looks and sizes

states.about: A field as it is, disabled, read only, and wrong. A field that is wrong states `aria-invalid`, so the styling and what a screen reader reads cannot disagree.
states.title: States
